messages:
maria: Quick sync — greenroom play for May 4 webinar. We need a coordinated X + LinkedIn push, a short benchmarking thread highlighting the latency vs cost lift, and an inbound routing plan for signups. Can we line up copy + hero by EOD Thu?

jake: Yep. I can draft two X teasers (short + bite) and a LinkedIn longform. Do we want a single benchmark narrative or 2 variants (developer vs executive)?

maria: Two variants please — dev orient (metrics, config tips) and exec orient (cost savings, ROI). X should point to sign-up; LinkedIn can host the expanded narrative.

elaine: Working on hero/thumbnail comps. Need sizes: X in-feed 1200x675, LinkedIn 1200x627, and a square fallback for social cards. I can do a dark and light variant. Will upload final PNGs with filenames: greenroom-hero-dark.png and greenroom-hero-light.png by Thu 5pm PT.

sam: For engagement: plan to 1) Pin X thread 2) Run 2 reply templates for first-hour outreach 3) Route inbound signups to SDR queue #webinar-inbound via the form webhook: https://hooks.redwood.example/webinar. Also add UTM tags: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=greenroom_may4&utm_medium=x_linkedin

nate: I can handle scheduling. Proposed cadence: X teaser 1 at 9:00am PT, benchmark thread at 11:00am PT, LinkedIn longform 12:30pm PT. Buffer job names: "greenroom-tease", "greenroom-thread", "greenroom-linkedin". Example schedule command: ```buffer schedule --name greenroom-thread --time "2026-05-04T11:00:00-07:00" --assets greenroom-hero-dark.png```

jake: CTA options: 1) "Save your seat" (high conversion) 2) "See the benchmark" (more product-y). My pick: X uses 1, LinkedIn uses 2 + signup link. Also include a short thread opener: "We cut per-token cost by 43% without impacting latency — here’s how." Thoughts?

maria: Love it. Use CTA 1 on X and CTA 2 on LinkedIn. For the thread opener, make dev copy include the config snippet and exec copy start with savings stat. Keep the benchmark claim backed by the small footnote: "internal perf test, typical workload; results vary."

elaine: Uploaded comps to #assets -> /marketing/greenroom/ with alt text. Filenames: greenroom-hero-dark.png, greenroom-hero-light.png, greenroom-thumb-square.png. Leaving layered Figma file: Greenroom_Social_v3.fig.

ops-bot: Reminder: calendar event created "Greenroom Webinar — Promo Day" on 2026-05-04 at 08:30 PT. Invitation sent to @marketing and @growth.

sam: Who's monitoring the first hour for replies/asks? We should triage questions, surface leads to SDRs, and escalate any product questions to eng-bridge.

jake: I can monitor first hour + hand off followups to Sam. Will set reminders.

maria: Perfect. Final checklist: copy drafts from Jake (EOD Thu), assets from Elaine (Thu 5pm PT), scheduling by Nate (Fri morning), monitoring covered. Tag @ops-bot for final publish trigger. :rocket:

elaine: Will drop a last-minute alt for high-contrast accessibility by Thu 3pm.

maria: Thanks all — posting plan locked once assets + copy confirmed. If anything slips, call it out here.
